name: Vary
description: Make a variation of an image with a generation model (img2img). Subtle keeps the composition, strong reimagines it.

model.description: Generation model (a catalog model name that accepts an image input).

prompt.description: Prompt (default: empty; reuse the image's original prompt for best results).

strength.description: How far the variation may move away from the image: low keeps the composition and details close, high reinvents more of it.

seed.description: Fixed seed for a reproducible result (default: random).
